note: The actor contract buys TOS with WTON on the TOS/WTON pool in the front leg (WTON obtained via WETH on the WETH/WTON pool). The victim then buys TOS on the same pool, and the back leg sells all the TOS and routes the WTON back to WETH. WETH net is 20.529028 - 19.937134 = +0.591894, minus the 0.307785 ETH forwarded to 0x0708… in the back leg, gives 0.284109. After 0.018576 ETH gas the result is about +0.2655 ETH, with no residual token.
